retirement.requires: Replacement release passes the forced failure, retained-data purge, fingerprint identity, mixed-writer, repeated-boot and response-bearing application-log projection, guard and resumable-cleanup regressions before removing this carry.

Carry 0169 adapts Home upstream PR 168. Retire after the pinned Home returns atomically saved credential IDs from v8 OAuth completion, including the first plugin success poll, and passes the real Claude exchange, cross-handler receipt, cancellation, forced failure rollback, pending-secret purge, expiry and legacy-response regressions. No Executor storage or protocol change is required.

Retire after pinned Home escapes embedded CR and LF after formatting all log fields, emits exactly one physical line per record, and passes formatter and real-child snapshot/exit-receipt injection regressions without changing request handling.

Retire after native Home exposes dedicated conditional credential and membership deletion routes which compare the approved PostgreSQL full-row checksum under the mutation lock, refuse stale rows without deletion, and pass refresh-race and unchanged-row deletion regressions.

Retire after pinned Home provides validated connection limits, idle and lifetime expiry, preserves direct transport and advisory locks, exposes pool wait counters, and passes bounded concurrent load with config apply and liveness plus maintenance and log writes without changing deadlines.

Retire after pinned Home selects a configured stable schema owner inside each existing PostgreSQL DDL transaction, preserves owner identity and retained schema/privacy data through transaction pooling, resets the role on commit and rollback, and passes the real multi-process shared-budget and pooled liveness proofs.

Retire after the pinned Home uses xAI device authorization, keeps device secrets server-side, honors provider expiry and cancellation, saves the existing credential shape with an atomic exact-ID completion receipt, and passes the device start, exchange, expiry, denial, pending, slow-down and cancellation regressions.

Retire after pinned Home advertises a supported Grok CLI client version for both subscription billing reads and passes real collector HTTP 426 rejection, saved monthly and weekly quota, and unchanged credential, permission, rate-limit and outage classification regressions.

Retire after pinned Home emits one bounded metadata-only record per claimed quota collection with account references and returned vendor window field paths and durations before parsing, and passes actual collector, omitted and unusable window, privacy and real-child container stdout regressions.
remove when the pin moves to ≥ v1.1.8 and the upstream paid omitted-zero, free/unknown-profile, retained-window, supported-client and metadata-only collection regressions pass on the new pin.

Retire after pinned Home exposes bounded per-collection field-presence, null and quantity-validity handoffs independently of logs, and the authenticated pool view preserves them in pool-owned storage without response bodies, amounts or credentials. Home database models and versions must remain unchanged.

Retire after pinned Home exposes bounded xAI monthly and weekly source-field flags tied to collector invocation time, distinguishes forced claim refusal and vendor completion persistence, and passes field-shape, privacy, real-collector, lease-loss, write-failure and management-detail regressions, preserves same-attempt completion ordering and pool-owned persistence through the existing authenticated view without response bodies, amounts or credentials, and does so without changing Home database models or versions.

Retire after pinned Home treats omitted weekly percentages and on-demand usage as not reported, never infers zero, preserves valid monthly readings and rejects present invalid optional values. Pass observed-shape, explicit-zero, alias, malformed-value, retained-window and real-collector regressions without changing Home database models or versions.

Retire after pinned Home accepts valid monthly and weekly quota omissions as healthy unmetered collections, never invents measured amounts, rejects present invalid values and real request errors, and an authoritative omission replaces old measurements and clears earlier collection failures. Pass persisted-collector, public-health, period, alias, malformed-field, explicit-zero and failure-recovery regressions without changing Home database models or versions.

Retire only after the pinned source preserves credit observations, pool-owned policy and plan-before-affinity selection, passes the never-policy and retained WebSocket turn proofs, and preserves existing schema rows through additive upgrades.
Retire only when the pinned source emits the same closed stage timings and passes success, failure, privacy, duration-bound and real-child projection regressions without changing dispatch behavior.

Retire after pinned Home recognizes the GrokPro paid subscription tier, preserves explicitly reported numeric weekly and product percentages, retains a closed malformed, missing, ambiguous, non-string or unknown-tier profile eligibility reason with fixed field-type flags only, and passes the real-collector, unknown-profile and free-profile regressions without changing Home database models or versions.

Retire only when the pinned sources preserve the opt-in primary dispatch reply, bounded closed timing transport, failure fencing, legacy compatibility and synthetic-provider response proof through Worker logs without exposing diagnostic headers to clients.

Retire when the pinned Home reads credential identity, quota snapshots and quota windows for funding selection in one authoritative SQL statement, preserving old-result parity, soft deletion, expiry and missing-data semantics, with PostgreSQL concurrent-update and query-budget proof. Admission and management loaders remain unchanged.

Retire only after the pinned Home preserves eligible sticky and parent sessions, prefers the earliest fresh account-wide weekly reset among plan-funded candidates with five-hour fallback, keeps model limits as eligibility gates and credits last, supports reversible per-pool balanced selection, migrates retained v14 data additively and passes admission, privacy, policy and repeated-boot regressions.

Retire after the pinned source preserves generic model weekly windows and reset grant kind, scope, count, expiry and normalized effects through retained snapshots and management reads, with default-off bounded diagnostic discovery and no reset redemption.

Retire after pinned Home preserves narrow exact timestamp/string-ID summary pages, transactional late-commit and attribution-repair pending work with token-fenced acknowledgement, exact portable queue restoration, time-bounded first-success key identity, PR 171 overview semantics and online index readiness. Preserve retained v15 rows without legacy normalization, concurrent startup, interrupted-index repair and old-writer compatibility, and ship only with the strict native schema activation barrier.

Retire after pinned Home provides native one-shot database migration, no-database schema info and read-only schema checks covering the exact schema marker and all required indexes. Preserve no-op when schema and all required indexes are ready, index completion when schema is already current, newer schema and wrong-definition refusal, cancellation, retained rows and readiness with one connection without raising connection budgets. Exit before lifecycle, repository, provider, listener or maintenance startup and return bounded JSON without secrets or native diagnostics. Pass actual PostgreSQL migration, rollback, concurrent startup and read-only repeated-no-op regressions.

Retire after pinned Home renews each exact PostgreSQL membership in one atomic statement with membership-before-Home locks, post-lock database time, fenced-lifetime refusal and unchanged three-second heartbeat/five-second cancellation bounds, and exposes a database-free process-health endpoint. Preserve SQLite behavior and supervisor startup, generation, transition and slow-audit readiness gates without delaying child-exit recovery.

Retire after pinned Home publishes steady single-part PostgreSQL observations in one statement with fresh membership authority, post-lock database time and a concurrent-attempt snapshot guard; preserves cold, multipart, invalid, replay and stale-revision behavior; renews exact Home incarnations in one locked statement; and persists semantic node changes with bounded nonempty retention refresh and no empty periodic writes. Preserve observation, liveness, fencing and draining bounds without a schema or lease change.

Retire only after the pinned selector preserves forecast-paced quota deadlines, retained smooth weighted credits, fallback and affinity safety, admission retry, bounded private decision evidence and current read-only snapshots. Prove staggered-reset availability and independent capacity-shortfall classification through the public pool API without exposing uninspectable account facts.

Retire after the pinned Home narrow cursor and pending summary feeds preserve the stored service-tier identity, retain unknown auto values without guessing, and pass the known-tier, unknown-tier and metadata-only privacy regressions.

Retire only when pinned Home excludes expired OAuth credentials and its five-minute dispatch safety window before model-state, scheduler, full-credential and affinity admission. Prove no stale upstream dispatch, next-account fallback, clean temporary unavailability, same-UUID fresh replacement and quota-deadline compatibility through native public requests.

Replacement release passes the forced failure, retained-data purge, fingerprint identity, mixed-writer, repeated-boot and response-bearing application-log projection, guard and resumable-cleanup regressions before removing this carry.

Retire this carry only after the replacement serves native System One through Home authority and execution, preserves native errors and accounting, and passes stock SDK, compression, multipart, current-generation catalog and revocation proofs. A forced failure during mirror creation, reconnect or deletion must leave no usable stale credential and must recover on retry without replacing the saved Executor account. Migrate each current mirror to the replacement binding before removing the old path, then purge the retired mirrored Home credentials while retaining original Executor token fields and unrelated Home accounts. Prove that the purge is scoped, resumable after a forced failure and idempotent across repeated boots, with no retired credential selectable after unlink, deletion or generation replacement.

Retire only after the pinned source preserves credit observations, pool-owned policy and plan-before-affinity selection, passes the never-policy and retained WebSocket turn proofs, and preserves existing schema rows through additive upgrades.
Retire only when the pinned source emits the same closed stage timings and passes success, failure, privacy, duration-bound and real-child projection regressions without changing dispatch behavior.

Retire only when the pinned sources preserve the opt-in primary dispatch reply, bounded closed timing transport, failure fencing, legacy compatibility and synthetic-provider response proof through Worker logs without exposing diagnostic headers to clients.

Retire after metadata-only Node usage publication preserves only allowlisted canonical API paths in its detached context, omits arbitrary paths and all other request metadata, and passes context, queue publication and fresh Home-capture regressions.

Retire only after the pinned node preserves the opt-in basalt.model-drain.v1 sequence and exact-length read receipts, unbuffered private input handoff, bounded messages, raw Responses compatibility and no inference replay, with the native v2 slow-consumer and real node reader proofs.

Retire after the pinned Node propagates validated per-request terminal correlation identities through HTTP, multiplexed Responses and duplex successor usage, preserves independent trace and billing execution identities through metadata-only reporting, and passes the request, privacy and model-drain regressions.

Retire only when the pinned Node exposes a private single-use connection completion channel that binds the actual model socket, preserves unmarked raw frames and public subprotocols, closes the data socket if completion becomes uncertain, and passes normal, client, upstream, revocation, duplicate-claim and draining-retirement regressions without inference replay or a byte-lifetime cap.

Retire when the pinned upstream release includes terminal unknown-outcome classification after HTTP submission and passes the real post-write EOF, empty accepted model-pool stream, late truncation, incomplete SSE frames, malformed accepted decoding, submitted POST redirects, header-only framing, terminal request-body closure, generation-only submission tracking with replayable token counting, exactly one request-scoped failed stream result for local and Home observers, JSON document error envelopes, terminal Antigravity credits fallback across model pools and credentials, buffered Claude incomplete-response classification, direct Fast credential-rate-limit result recording and cooldown, internal POST replay, pre-write connect failure and explicit HTTP and SSE refusal regressions. Preserve no replay across models, credentials and retry rounds, public 502 upstream_outcome_unknown with retryable false, existing proxy and protocol selection, and release updates. Re-apply on each source update until the upstream fix is released; remove this carry when that release supplies the same behavior.

Retire when the pinned Node tests implement approved ValidateUsageCreditTurn methods for the five retained-account Home dispatcher fixtures, all five original assertions pass with no product Go changes, the CI Node test selector includes those exact names without dropping existing selections, and funding-denial and missing-validator controls remain passing.

Retire after the pinned upstream release guards only generation sends, treats every local failure after accepted HTTP responses or ambiguous WebSocket frame writes as terminal unknown, and positively validates provider refusal payloads before allowing failover. Pass actual provider and native public error projections, two-credential HTTP and WebSocket disconnect and partial-write proofs, nil-connection pre-write recovery, plugin and token-count auxiliary controls, and retained Home funding fixtures without weakening assertions. Preserve no automatic replay across models, credentials or retry rounds, native error envelopes and correlation identities. Generic credential, refresh and auxiliary HTTP calls remain untracked. Re-apply on each source update until the upstream release supplies the same behavior.
